title: A Undertow for the Postcards
author: Oscar Thackeray
blurb: Freya Nystrom, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
